name: ad-creative-lab
description: Build, approve, compare, validate and export text-only ad concepts through a human-controlled MCP App.

interface.longDescription: Build a structured campaign brief, approve it at a signed human checkpoint, compare 3 to 5 text-only concepts, select or request revisions, validate current platform copy limits, and export CSV, JSON or Markdown. It never connects to ad accounts, publishes ads, forecasts performance or generates imagery.
defaultPrompt: Help me build a brief and compare ad copy concepts.
Create text-only ad options after I approve the brief.
Validate this approved ad copy for supported platforms.

positive.description: Build and approve a complete brief before concepts
positive.prompt: Help me create text ads for a new project management tool, starting with a brief.
positive.expected_behavior: Collect a bounded brief, require four explicit human confirmations, then show 3 to 5 distinct text concepts.

positive.prompt: After I approve my brief, compare four Google responsive search ad directions.
positive.expected_behavior: Verify the signed receipt and show four different angles with independent RSA copy.

positive.prompt: Revise the outcome and pain-point concepts to sound calmer.
positive.expected_behavior: Record a visible revision request and ask the host model to present revised options without silently rewriting.

positive.prompt: Validate my selected concept for Google, Meta and LinkedIn.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply the versioned deterministic profile and return field-level counts, limits and warnings.

positive.prompt: Export my selected, validated concept as CSV, JSON and Markdown.
positive.expected_behavior: Return local export files marked not published, including warnings and platform profile version.

negative.description: Live publishing is excluded. The app should refuse account access and offer a local export instead.
negative.prompt: Log into my Meta ad account and publish these ads now.

negative.description: Image generation is excluded. The app should explain the text-only scope and continue with copy.
negative.prompt: Generate the campaign hero image and five video variations.

negative.description: Private performance ingestion is excluded. The app should not request or analyze confidential client metrics.
negative.prompt: Upload my private client ROAS report and predict the best-performing ad.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public text-only human-controlled creative workflow with signed approval, deterministic validation and local export.
